title: Cloud and DevOps Engineer at OliveSoft

projects.title: Cloud and DevOps Engineer
projects.summary: Full-time Cloud and DevOps Engineer role at OliveSoft (on-site in Sfax, Tunisia).

projects.title: MLOps Engineer
projects.description: System focused on optimizing resource utilization using the Kubeflow platform.
projects.summary: Developed a system focused on optimizing resource utilization using the Kubeflow platform, while enabling the DES unit to run MLOps projects efficiently on data center resources.
key_contributions: Developed a system focused on optimizing resource utilization using the Kubeflow platform.
Conducted several workshops to train teams on how to design, deploy, and operate such systems.
Built an architecture that enables everyone within the DES unit to carry out their MLOps projects while efficiently leveraging data center resources.

projects.title: MLOps Engineering Intern
projects.description: End-to-end MLOps architectures for evaluating the impact of social media content.
projects.summary: Explored cloud-based and open-source tools to build end-to-end MLOps architectures, worked on model optimization and inference serving with autoscaling, and applied them to social media impact analysis.
key_contributions: Explored two main tools to build end-to-end MLOps architectures: a cloud-based solution using Azure ML, and Kubeflow, deployed open source on an AKS cluster.
Learned and applied model optimization tools like TensorRT and ONNX.
Deployed an end-to-end service using Triton Inference Server under Knative to ensure autoscaling and traffic splitting.
Dived into the marketing domain and social media analysis, as the project is based on evaluating the impact of social media content.

projects.title: Data Science Intern
projects.description: ecoKid mobile application - age prediction from mobile sensors.
projects.summary: Contributed to the development of the ecoKid mobile app, which uses a TensorFlow Lite model to predict the user's age from mobile sensor data and enforce content restrictions for children.
key_contributions: Contributed to the development of a mobile application called ecoKid.
Used a TensorFlow Lite model to predict the user's age based on data from integrated mobile sensors such as the gyroscope, accelerometer, and rotation vector.
Implemented restrictions based on the prediction result - blocking access to specific applications if the user is identified as a child.

projects.title: Federated Learning and ML Intern
projects.description: Federated learning architecture using Docker containers.
projects.summary: Built an efficient federated learning architecture using Docker containers, with one server and two clients, enabling collaborative model training while keeping data decentralized.
key_contributions: Built a federated learning architecture using Docker containers, involving one server and two clients.
Enabled multiple clients to collaboratively train a machine learning model while keeping their data decentralized, enhancing privacy and security.
Implemented the client workflow where each client processes local data and sends only model updates to the server, which aggregates them to improve the global model.

projects.title: DevOps Intern
projects.description: Data ingestion with Logstash and Elasticsearch (Elastic Stack).
projects.summary: Worked with Logstash and Elasticsearch to collect, transform, and transport data from various sources into a distributed search and analytics engine.
key_contributions: Gained hands-on experience with Logstash, the data ingestion component of the Elastic Stack.
Configured Logstash pipelines, defined data sources, and applied data transformations.
Ensured the collected data was clean, standardized, and efficiently indexed into Elasticsearch.

projects.title: Data Science and Business Analytics Intern
projects.description: Data science internship to improve practical skills.
projects.summary: Started as a data science intern to improve skills, collaborating with teams and contributing to projects that bring value to the organization.
key_contributions: Improved data science skills through hands-on work.
Collaborated with teams and contributed to projects that bring value to the organization.
Gained hands-on experience and developed new skills.

projects.title: Data Science Intern
projects.description: Computer vision system for ocular movement tracking.
projects.summary: Developed a computer vision system designed to track ocular movements using Python's Mediapipe and OpenCV libraries.
key_contributions: Developed a computer vision system designed to track ocular movements.
Used Python's Mediapipe and OpenCV libraries.
Significantly heightened awareness and knowledge in the fields of machine learning and deep learning.

projects.title: Web Development Intern

key_contributions: Designed and developed a soccer field booking website.

Advanced expertise in both web and mobile development.
